openFindings.title: Duplicated comment banner in deep-review-auto.yaml header
openFindings.description: The separator/title comment banner at the top of deep-review-auto.yaml is duplicated verbatim (lines 1-3 and 3-5).

openFindings.title: Confirm workflow lacks resource-map coverage audit step
openFindings.description: deep-review-confirm.yaml emits the resource map but has no step_resource_map_coverage_gate, which deep-review-auto.yaml:2150 and loop-protocol Step 3b require when resource_map_present is true.

openFindings.title: Deep-review loop-protocol understates shipped write-containment posture
openFindings.description: The executor-resolution section claims prompt contract + post-dispatch validation are the ONLY containment mechanisms for review CLI lanes, but the git-diff guard (write-containment.ts) runs in every executor branch of deep-review-auto.yaml (1443-1795), deep-review-confirm.yaml (1145-1191), and fanout-run.cjs (3376-3494).

openFindings.title: Deep-research loop-protocol self-contradicts on containment mechanisms
openFindings.description: Line 275 says the only containment is prompt contract + post-dispatch validation, directly above lines 287-290 documenting the two containment rules binding every CLI lineage.

openFindings.title: Hub SKILL.md improvement-mode count contradicts registry and itself
openFindings.description: Line 80 claims 3 improvement modes share the deep-improvement packet; mode-registry.json registers two improvement lanes (agent-improvement, model-benchmark) and SKILL.md:58 says two.

openFindings.title: Compiled-contracts README counts four contracts where three exist
openFindings.description: The OVERVIEW says the directory stores four flattened command contracts, but only three .contract.md files exist and the README's own next paragraph says three commands.
